issues.legal_issue: A cheque delivered within the time allowed for a court-ordered payment satisfies the payment condition when the order does not require payment in cash and the cheque is subsequently honoured.
material_facts: The payment order required a deposit within a specified period but did not state that the deposit had to be made in cash.
An earlier amount had been deposited, and a further amount was delivered by cheque on the last day of the period.
The cheque was subsequently honoured and encashed.
There was no finding or other indication that the cheque would not have been honoured if presented on the day it was delivered.
The appellant had also given the undertaking required by the payment order.
issues.conclusion: The payment conditions were substantially complied with, and the appellant was entitled to the benefit of the order.
issues.legal_principle: Unless an order specifically requires payment in cash, payment by cheque is due payment if the cheque is subsequently honoured in the ordinary course. Under Commissioner of Income Tax, Bombay South, Bombay v. Messrs Ogale Glass Works Ltd., A.I.R. 1954 S.C. 429, payment by a cheque that is honoured and encashed relates back to the date the cheque was received. The terms and intent of the order govern the time and mode of payment; the court held that the time for payment was governed by its order, rather than the High Court’s Original Side Rules, Order XXXI Rules 1–6.

rule.if: court_ordered_deposit_compliance_proceeding and order_did_not_require_cash and required_sum_was_tendered_within_time and timely_cheque_was_later_honoured and not evidence_cheque_would_be_dishonoured and required_undertaking_was_given

predicates.court_ordered_deposit_compliance_proceed: The proceeding concerns whether a party complied with a court order requiring a deposit.
predicates.order_did_not_require_cash: The court order required payment but did not specify that it had to be made in cash.
predicates.required_sum_was_tendered_within_time: The party tendered the sum required by the order within the time it allowed, including any amount previously deposited toward that sum.
predicates.timely_cheque_was_later_honoured: A cheque tendered within the time allowed was subsequently honoured and encashed.
predicates.evidence_cheque_would_be_dishonoured: There was evidence that the cheque would not have been honoured if presented when delivered.
predicates.required_undertaking_was_given: The party gave any undertaking required by the payment order.

issues.definition: In a proceeding about compliance with a court-ordered deposit, when the required sum and any required undertaking are provided on time, the order does not require cash, and a timely cheque is honoured without evidence it would have been dishonoured, the payment condition is treated as satisfied.
